auth.signInLead: For families, care teams and research partners.
auth.badCredentials: That email and password don't match, or the account is locked for 15 minutes after too many tries.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then sign in again.
auth.mfaVerifyLead: Open your authenticator app and type the code shown for Tomoni.
auth.mfaEnrollLead: Care teams and partners need a second step, because you can see patient information. Scan this code with an authenticator app, then type the 6 digits it shows.
auth.mfaManual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
auth.badCode: That code didn't match. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
auth.chooseSurface: Where do you want to go?
auth.wrongApp: This account is for the research partner portal. Sign in there instead.
auth.notPartner: This portal is for research partners only. Families and care teams sign in to the main Tomoni app.

family.emptyBody: Once Tomoni has checked your family's medicines, each person's status shows here every morning, with anything that needs you at the top.
family.summaryNeedsYou: {count, plural, one {# thing needs you soon} other {# things need you soon}}
family.summaryComingUp: Nothing urgent. {count, plural, one {# thing is coming up} other {# things are coming up}}.
family.summaryClear: All clear. Every medicine is covered for the next 60 days.
family.noMedicines: No medicines yet. They appear here once Medicare is connected.
family.connectHelp: {name} signs in to Medicare.gov once, and Tomoni reads pharmacy claims from then on.
family.connectFailed: Couldn't start the connection. Try again in a minute.

medicareNotice.connected: Medicare is connected. Medicines show up here within a minute.
medicareNotice.expired: That Medicare link expired. Start again from the button below.
medicareNotice.declined: Medicare access wasn't given, so nothing was connected.
medicareNotice.failed: Medicare didn't answer. Nothing was connected; try again later.

w.run_out: {drug} runs out {when} and has no refills left. The doctor needs to renew it.
w.late_refill: {drug} ran out {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago and hasn't been refilled.
w.premium_jump: The {plan} premium goes from {before} to {after} a month on {date}.
w.formulary_removal: {plan} stops covering {drug} from {date}. The first refill this affects is {problemDate}.
w.tier_change: {drug} moves from tier {before} to tier {after} on {plan} from {date}, so it will likely cost more.
w.negotiated_price_change: On {plan}, 30 days of {drug} goes from about {before} to {after} from {date}.
w.pharmacy_closure: {pharmacy} closes on {date}. {count, plural, one {# medicine is} other {# medicines are}} filled there.
w.shortage: {drug} is in short supply nationally. Its next refill is due {problemDate}.
w.gene_drug_mismatch: The doctor is reviewing a medicine.

evidence.fillsHeading: Pharmacy claims this is based on

act.waitingDoctor: Waiting for the doctor to sign.

act.failed: Tomoni couldn't finish this. The care team will follow up.

desk.queueEmptyBody: Refill renewals, approvals and nurse flags appear here, most urgent first.
desk.detailEmpty: Pick an item from the queue. Its evidence shows here, so you never have to look anything up.
desk.simHelp: Test the daily call end to end. You type as the patient; nothing is dialed. Flags you trigger reach the nurse queue like real ones.
desk.simNoConsent: This patient hasn't agreed to calls, so Tomoni won't call them.
desk.simError: Couldn't reach the call engine. Try again.

what.draftFormularyException: Ask the plan to keep covering {drug}

ops.title: Escalations
ops.emptyBody: Calls the assistant hands over, and jobs that need a person, appear here.

sponsor.title: Research partner portal
sponsor.lead: Counts here are de-identified and aggregated. Groups smaller than 11 people are never shown.
sponsor.emptyBody: When a study is set up with Tomoni, feasibility counts and the referral funnel appear here.

admin.pbmHelp: Choose the CSV the PBM sent, then tell Tomoni which column is which. Rows that don't fit are set aside and listed, never guessed at.
